description: Incidenti stradali in Europa - Anni 2001-2018 is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministero Infrastrutture e Trasporti. Il dataset contiene dati relativi al 2018 e confronti storici relativi al periodo 2001-2018 sull'incidentalità stradale nei 28 Paesi della UE; sono presenti 2 diversi set di dati. I dati sono estratti dal materiale statistico del MIT. Coverage: Italy. The portal files it under the publisher Ministero Infrastrutture e Trasporti. Its tags are feriti, incidentalita, incidenti, minf, veicoli. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-01-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
